lines.en: Luca, have you heard? The blender you bought last month has been recalled, and a notice was sent to every customer.
lines.pt: Luca, você soube? O liquidificador que você comprou no mês passado foi recolhido, e um aviso foi enviado a todos os clientes.

lines.en: No! I haven’t received anything. Which model has been affected, exactly?
lines.pt: Não! Não recebi nada. Qual modelo foi afetado, exatamente?

lines.en: The silver one. A fault was found in the motor, and several customers have been warned not to use it.
lines.pt: O prateado. Foi encontrada uma falha no motor, e vários clientes foram avisados para não usá-lo.

lines.en: I use it every morning! Fortunately, nothing has been damaged yet, but I should stop using it at once.
lines.pt: Eu uso todas as manhãs! Felizmente, nada foi danificado ainda, mas devo parar de usá-lo imediatamente.

lines.en: Right. The shop has been told to remove all the units, and the whole section has already been emptied.
lines.pt: Isso. A loja foi instruída a retirar todas as unidades, e a seção inteira já foi esvaziada.

lines.en: Then I’ll take mine back today. Do you think they will give me my money back?
lines.pt: Então vou devolver o meu hoje. Você acha que vão me devolver o dinheiro?

lines.en: They should. The manufacturer has been asked to cover all costs, so refunds have been promised.
lines.pt: Devem devolver. O fabricante foi solicitado a cobrir todos os custos, então reembolsos foram prometidos.

lines.en: Good. By the way, how was the problem discovered? Did someone get hurt?
lines.pt: Ótimo. A propósito, como o problema foi descoberto? Alguém se machucou?

lines.en: Luckily not. It was reported by a customer, and the factory was inspected last week.
lines.pt: Felizmente não. Foi relatado por um cliente, e a fábrica foi inspecionada na semana passada.

lines.en: That is a relief. I’ll check my email in case the notice has been sent to my old address.
lines.pt: Que alívio. Vou conferir meu e-mail, caso o aviso tenha sido enviado para meu endereço antigo.

lines.en: Good thinking. And keep the receipt, because the form has to be signed and returned before Friday.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. E guarde o recibo, porque o formulário precisa ser assinado e devolvido antes de sexta.

facts.big: has/have been + particípio: o passivo que chega ao presente
facts.label: Avisos ao consumidor
facts.sub: The product has been recalled. Customers have been warned. Has it been fixed? Nothing has been damaged.

facts.label: has been recalled
facts.sub: Use have/has been + particípio quando o resultado importa agora: The product has been recalled. Em português: “foi recolhido”. Não diga “has recalled”.

facts.label: have been warned
facts.sub: Com sujeito plural, use have been: Customers have been warned. Refunds have been promised. Com sujeito singular, use has been: The notice has been sent.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “o produto foi recolhido” com o passado do passivo.
compare.us: Em inglês, quando o efeito chega ao presente, usamos has been + particípio: The product has been recalled.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: The product has been recalled.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Has been recalled is a present perfect passive.

items.why: We say The product has been recalled.

items.s: The agent is often omitted when it is not important.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Has been recalled is a present perfect passive. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
We say “The product has recalled”. → Falso (We say The product has been recalled.)
The agent is often omitted when it is not important. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: A product recall · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a busy Saturday in Chicago. Abby is reading the news in a small shop. A warning has just been published online. Leo walks in with a shopping bag. The two friends talk about a kitchen product. Something is clearly wrong.

“Leo, have you heard? The blender you bought last month has been recalled, and a notice was sent to every customer.” says Abby. “No! I haven’t received anything. Which model has been affected, exactly?” says Leo. “The silver one. A fault was found in the motor, and several customers have been warned not to use it.” says Abby.
